newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SmarTone trades below issue price on debut.
newsitem.headline: SmarTone trades below issue price on debut.

text.p: SmarTone Telecommunications Holdings Ltd shares fell below their issue price following their trading debut on Thursday, with investors concerned that a low IPO subscription level would mean limited upside for the shares.
The stock opened at HK$17.25, unchanged from its initial public offering price, before falling to a session low of HK$16.70 around midday.

"The fall was a bit disappointing as we initially expected support at the issue price level," said Sean Li, associate director at Amsteel Securities. "Investors sold the shares due to the low subscription level and pricey issue price."
The Hong Kong flotation of the mobile telephone operator was 2.95 times subscribed.
Analysts said worries over SmarTone's future earnings prospects due to keen competition in the telecommunications industry dampened investor interest in the stock.
